datum: Graciously hear, O Lord Jesus Christ, the prayers of Thy servants, + and have mercy upon us: * Who livest and reignest with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, world without end.

lectio-i: May the Eternal Father bless us * with an eternal blessing.
lectio-ii: May the Son, the Sole-begotten, * mercifully bless and keep us.
lectio-iii: May the grace of God the Spirit * all our heart and mind enlighten.

datum: May His loving-kindness and mercy help us, * Who liveth and reigneth with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, world without end.

lectio-i: God the Father Omnipotent, * be to us merciful and clement.
lectio-ii: May Christ to all His people give, * for ever in His sight to live.
lectio-iii: May the Spirit’s fire Divine * in our hearts enkindled shine.

datum: From the bonds of our sins, * may the Almighty and merciful Lord loose us.
May the Gospel’s holy lection * be our safety and protection.
May His blessing be upon us * Who doth live and reign for ever.
May the divine assistance * remain always with us.
He whose feast-day we are keeping, * be our Advocate with God.
They whose feast-day we are keeping, * be our Advocates with God.
She whose feast-day we are keeping, * be our Advocate with God.
She whose feast-day we are keeping * Mary, blessed Maid of Maidens, be our Advocate with God.
May He that is the Angels’ King * to that high realm His people bring.
May the Gospel’s glorious word * cleansing to our souls afford.
By the prayers of the Blessed Mary, always a Virgin, and by the prayers of all the Saints, * and for her sake and for their sakes, may the Lord lead us unto the kingdom of heaven.

lectio-i: Bless us, Mary, Maiden mild, * Bless us, Jesus, Mary’s Child.
lectio-ii: With the Lord Who sprang of thee, * Maid of maidens, plead for me.
lectio-iii: Through the Virgin mother concede to us O Lord * safety and peace.
